source_refs.note: Topic 26.2.2 (PDF 151-152); Figure 26.4 (photographs of nylon products) is given as a list.

items: Clothing (stockings, activewear and swimwear), carpets and ropes, because of its strength and elasticity; its fabric is used for raincoats and sportswear.
Mechanical parts in the automotive industry, such as gears, bearings, bushings, engine covers and fuel lines, because of its strength, low friction and heat resistance.
Machine parts such as screws, nuts and bolts, where strength and wear resistance are needed.
Ropes, fishing nets and lines, because of its high tensile strength and resistance to wear in water.
Consumer goods such as zips, toothbrushes, hairbrushes and many moulded plastic parts.

blocks.prompt: Why is nylon used for fishing nets?
blocks.explanation: It has high tensile strength and resists wear in water.

items: Nylon uses: clothing, carpets, ropes, gears and bearings, screws and bolts, fishing nets, zips and brushes.
